description: A page. One half of the Page <-> Block cross-file cycle. Because the cycle spans two input files, Page and Block hoist together into Python's _recursive.py; the non-cyclic PageMeta helper stays in this module.

blocks.description: Ordered content blocks. Cross-file `$ref` to block.json (same directory); the array is the terminating edge of the cycle.

PageMeta.description: Non-cyclic helper. Referenced only by Page, references nothing recursive, so it stays in the content_page module even though Page is hoisted.
